# WAPlusXposed

WAPlusXposed is a lightweight Xposed module designed to unlock the <ins>official premium features</ins> within **WhatsApp** and **WhatsApp Business**. By utilizing dynamic APK analysis, the module supports newer WhatsApp versions automatically.

## [Source Code & Support](https://github.com/RevealedSoulEven/WAPlusXposed)

> **🌟 What's New:** WhatsApp Business is now supported!

> If the module is not updated for a while, don't assume it is dead. It may still work as it dynamically hooks to the methods so updating it is rarely required. If it doesn't work, feel free to [open an issue](https://github.com/RevealedSoulEven/WAPlusXposed/issues).


## Features

* Unlocks premium customization features including exclusive visual themes, native app launcher icons, premium sticker packs, custom ringtones, and much more.
* **Optimized Execution:** Uses DexKit to dynamically scan the target application combined with a robust caching manager to ensure fast initialization and compatibility across application updates.

---

## Requirements

* A rooted Android device or an environment supporting hook frameworks.
* **LSPosed Framework** (or a compatible Xposed implementation) installed and active.

---

## Installation

1.  Download and install the latest `WAPlus` APK from the [Releases](https://github.com/RevealedSoulEven/WAPlusXposed/releases) section.
2.  Open your **LSPosed** manager application.
3.  Navigate to the modules section, locate **WAPlus**, and toggle **Enable Module**.
4.  Ensure **WhatsApp** and/or **WhatsApp Business** are enabled in the scope.
5.  Force close or restart WhatsApp / WhatsApp Business to apply the hooks.

---

## Technical Overview

The module operates using two primary layers:
* **DexKit Bridge:** Utilizes the DexKit library to scan the runtime APK on a fresh launch or update to locate targeted validation signatures dynamically.
* **Caching Manager:** Stores identified class and method signatures locally to bypass the scanning phase on subsequent launches.

---

## Special Thanks

This project would not be possible without the incredible work done by the developers of the core hooking and analysis libraries:

* **[DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit)** - For providing the powerful, high-performance APK signature searching capabilities.
* **[LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed)** - For the modern, cutting-edge ART hooking framework implementation.
* **[rovo89](https://github.com/rovo89/xposed)** - For the foundational revolutionary Xposed Framework that inspired modern Android modding.

---

#WAPlusXpose

WAPlusXposed 是一个轻量级 Xposed 模块，旨在解锁 **WhatsApp** 和 **WhatsApp Business** 中的<ins>官方高级功能</ins>。通过利用动态 APK 分析，该模块自动支持较新的 WhatsApp 版本。

## [源代码和支持](https://github.com/RevealedSoulEven/WAPlusXposed)

> **🌟 新消息：** 现已支持 WhatsApp Business！

> 如果模块有一段时间没有更新，不要认为它已经死了。它可能仍然可以工作，因为它动态挂钩到方法，因此很少需要更新它。如果它不起作用，请随时[打开问题](https://github.com/RevealedSoulEven/WAPlusXposed/issues)。


## 特点

* 解锁高级定制功能，包括独家视觉主题、本机应用程序启动器图标、高级贴纸包、定制铃声等等。
* **优化执行：** 使用 DexKit 动态扫描目标应用程序，并结合强大的缓存管理器，以确保快速初始化和跨应用程序更新的兼容性。

---

## 要求

* 已root的Android设备或支持hook框架的环境。
* **LSPosed Framework**（或兼容的 Xposed 实现）已安装并处于活动状态。

---

## 安装

1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/RevealedSoulEven/WAPlusXposed/releases) 部分下载并安装最新的 `WAPlus` APK。
2. 打开您的 **LSPosed** 管理器应用程序。
3. 导航至模块部分，找到 **WAPlus**，然后切换 **启用模块**。
4. 确保在范围内启用 **WhatsApp** 和/或 **WhatsApp Business**。
5. 强制关闭或重新启动 WhatsApp / WhatsApp Business 以应用挂钩。

---

## 技术概述

该模块使用两个主要层进行操作：
* **DexKit Bridge：** 利用 DexKit 库在新启动或更新时扫描运行时 APK，以动态定位目标验证签名。
* **缓存管理器：** 在本地存储已识别的类和方法签名，以绕过后续启动时的扫描阶段。

---

## 特别感谢

如果没有核心挂钩和分析库开发人员所做的令人难以置信的工作，这个项目就不可能实现：

* **[DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit)** - 提供强大、高性能的APK签名搜索功能。
* **[LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed)** - 用于现代、尖端的 ART hooking 框架实现。
* **[rovo89](https://github.com/rovo89/xposed)** - 启发现代 Android 改装的基础性革命性 Xpose 框架。

---
